# Samture

> Samture is a boutique AI architecture practice in Dubai, working with organisations in the United Arab Emirates and the wider Gulf. It designs the foundation that AI depends on: architecture, data governance, knowledge graphs, encrypted trust engineering and sovereign infrastructure, built as one connected structure rather than as separate advice. Every engagement is led personally by founder Madelein Leegwater.

Samture works with organisations in regulated sectors: financial services, government, healthcare and ICT. Engagements begin with a structural assessment, never with a tool. Areas of work: AI architecture, Knowledge graphs, Semantic layer, Data governance, AI governance and compliance, Encrypted trust engineering, Sovereign AI infrastructure, Ecosystem orchestration, AI readiness assessment.

- [Ecosystem](https://samture.com/ecosystem.html): Boutique at the helm, never small behind it: some twelve specialised partners across Europe, the Gulf and Asia, orchestrated under one accountability.

## Insights

- [AI's Last Mile](https://samture.com/insights/ais-last-mile.html): Spending on AI in the Emirates went up 105% in a year and the average maturity score came out at 48 out of 100. The gap is not wasted money, it is the part of the work that never appears in a business case.
- [The Mark Only Goes One Way](https://samture.com/insights/the-mark-only-goes-one-way.html): Since 2 August, machine involvement in a piece of work can be demonstrated. Human involvement still cannot. And the data minimisation policy you were right to write is widening the gap between the two.
- [The Chair Nobody Is Sitting In](https://samture.com/insights/the-chair-nobody-is-sitting-in.html): The DIFC has required a named Autonomous Systems Officer for high-risk AI since 2023. Almost nobody has filled the seat, and most architectures could not give that person anything to work with.
